# Acceptance-mode controls

`unsafe_many.bend` is the unchanged pinned original; see NOTICE. Its main returns
7 and never calls `twice`. `live.bend` actually invokes the nested reusable
function argument twice, returning 5n. Both require executable checking; their
earlier law intentionally fails strict Data formation.

The safe counterpart and later ordinary signature reject reusable function
domains. The latter must fail in `wrong`, not the preceding unsafe definition.
False reflexivity and a named unfinished hole remain failures under `@unsafe`.
These are tests of the existing contract, not a relaxation of the proof checker.
